We have restarted the pdf-renderer service to clear the error state. We are investigating a permanent fix for the missing font issue."}

response.text: The pdf-renderer service was restarting frequently due to a missing font 'NotoSans-Regular' in the image after the recent deploy. I confirmed the restart metric spike and error logs indicating the font issue. I restarted the pdf-renderer service to clear the error state and posted a status update to inform customers. Further investigation is needed to fix the missing font in the image permanently.
